about.title: The gap between wiring and the future.
about.text: Based in the heart of Gweru, 1229 Electricals is a premier Zimbabwean provider of specialised electrical, solar and appliance solutions. We bridge the gap between traditional electrical contracting and modern renewable energy technology, serving residential, commercial and agricultural clients with a commitment to safety, efficiency and long-term sustainability.
about.mission: To provide Gweru and the wider Zimbabwe region with safe, high-quality electrical and solar solutions through expert workmanship, technical integrity, and a commitment to protecting our clients' property and investments.
about.vision: To be the most trusted and influential energy partner in the Midlands and Zimbabwe, recognised for transforming Gweru into a hub of modern electrical safety and solar innovation by 2030.
about.promise: We do not take shortcuts. Whether it's tubing a new house or repairing a sensitive appliance, we adhere strictly to the highest electrical safety standards to ensure the longevity of your property.

pulse.pulseText: Electrical and solar systems are the pulse of a building. We design, install and maintain them with technical integrity.
pulse.perfectionText: Our Ceiling Division is the finish. By handling ceilings and electrical together, lighting, chandeliers and solar-powered fixtures are integrated into the design from day one, with no damage from outside contractors.
